evidence_excerpts: A significant positive correlation was found between shifts away from hard-materialism (the NPB factor) and changes in well-being. The correlation was significant at 4 weeks and at 6 months post-ceremony.
Figure 3. Shifts away from hard materialistic beliefs are associated with increases in well-being.
text: Shifts away from hard materialism are positively associated with increases in psychological well-being after psychedelic ceremonies.
